name: Gehna
sources: 73 unique ad texts and 25 headlines from the ad account
one_liner: Handcrafted 18K gold jewellery with natural gemstones, BIS Hallmarked, for women who love colour.
audience: Indian women, mostly 25 to 44, buying fine jewellery for themselves and as gifts. They want lightweight everyday gold, real gemstones and trust when buying online.

voice.summary: Warm, confident and short. Talks to one woman. Celebrates colour, craft and everyday wear, and backs every claim with proof.
do: Open with a short rhythmic line or a real customer quote
Name the material: 18K gold, natural gemstones, BIS Hallmarked
Stack proof at the end: hallmark, reviews, free shipping, easy returns
Keep lines short, one idea per line
Use 1 emoji at the end of a line
dont: Invent discounts, prices or dates that are not running
Use heavy luxury jargon or long paragraphs
Put more than 4 emojis in a caption or 1 in a headline
Claim lab-grown or diamonds unless the product has them

emoji.style: 1 emoji at the end of a line or headline. Sparkle and gem emojis most often.

copy_patterns: Rhythmic 3-line opener: Stack them. 💍 Layer them. 💎 Never take them off. 💖
Customer quote first, then: That's what 10,000+ Gehna customers sound like. 💬
Headline as product plus proof: Multi-Gemstone Bracelet | 18K Gold
Proof stack line: BIS Hallmarked, free shipping, 7-day easy returns. 💍
Question hook for new buyers: Thinking of buying jewellery online? 🤔
claims_note: Use only claims that are true for the product shown. Mention offers only while they are running.
sample_headlines: Real Gemstone Rings. Every Colour. Every Mood. 💎
Real Rings. Real Reviews. Real Gold. ✨
fonts: Headlines in an elegant serif on ad images. Clean modern sans on the website.
photography: Tight product close-ups that show real stone colour
Jewellery worn on skin: ears, hands, wrists and neck
Soft neutral or ivory backgrounds, sometimes deep maroon
